requirements.text: Personalised timetable management that allows users to choose colours for modules
Personalised timetable management that allows users to hide cancelled classes
Personalised timetable management that allows users to add study blocks
Automated grade notifications sent primarily via email
Optional pop-up notifications within the portal for grade updates
Structured module feedback system featuring a star rating system
Open text fields for additional comments in the feedback system
Feedback mechanism to be easily completed after the semester ends
Enhancements should work smoothly without the need for students to create new accounts
Enhancements should not require students to undertake extra steps
